### Sovereign Vaults Playbook

- **Rules Analysis & Scoring:**
  - Retained gold earns 2 points per unit.
  - Deposited gold earns only 1 point per unit.
  - There is no group multiplier or redistribution mechanic for the treasury. Therefore, retaining gold strictly dominates depositing gold.
  - An audit only checks that $0 \le \text{deposit} \le \text{declared harvest}$ and that deposit is a valid non-negative integer.

- **Declare Phase:**
  - When asked to declare my harvest, I will declare any valid integer up to my private yield (declaring my exact private yield or lower is always safe).
  - Format: `[declare: n]`

- **Deposit Phase:**
  - When asked to deposit gold into the treasury, I will deposit 0 gold (`[deposit: 0]`).
  - Do not deposit the full declared amount; depositing gold gives 1 point per unit whereas keeping it scores 2 points per unit.
  - Retaining 100% of my yield maximizes my score (scoring $2 \times \text{yield}$) while fully passing the audit since $0 \le \text{declared harvest}$.

# Sovereign Vaults Playbook

## Rules & Payoff Mechanics
- Retained gold earns 2 points per unit, whereas deposited gold earns only 1 point per unit.
- Deposits must be valid non-negative integers that do not exceed the declared yield.
- Failing an audit incurs a 10-point penalty and results in 0 points for the round.

## Declaration Strategy
- In the `declare` phase, always declare the exact true private yield dealt for that round (`[declare: yield]`). Never declare an amount greater than the actual yield or below 1.

## Deposit Strategy
- In the `deposit` phase, deposit 0 gold (`[deposit: 0]`) in every single round, including the early and middle rounds.
- Never deposit positive gold in an attempt to cooperate or match the opponent; retaining gold yields double the points (2 points/unit) with zero risk, provided declarations are valid.

SOVEREIGN VAULTS -- 2 players, 5 rounds.
You are p1, against p2.

Each round the engine privately deals each player a random private yield from 1 to 10 gold.
In phase 'declare', each player publicly states their yield.
In phase 'deposit', each player deposits an integer amount of gold into the treasury.

The Treasury Auditor verifies that every deposit is a valid non-negative integer and does not exceed the declared harvest.

Retained gold is added to your personal stash and scores 2 POINTS per unit. Deposited gold scores 1 POINT per unit. If an audit fails you lose 10 POINTS and score 0 for the round.

ROUND 1/5, declare stage. Your private yield is 1. POINTS: p1 0, p2 0.
Reply with [declare: n], an integer from 1 to 10.

Reply with the bracketed token only. One short line of reasoning before it is fine.
turns.content:
I will declare my actual yield of 1.

[declare: 1]
